title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the Ampere force magnitude using equilibrium: F_a = 2kx - mg = 3 N.

title: Ampere force direction
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the direction of the Ampere force as vertically downward using the left-hand rule.

title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnetic field magnitude using B = F_a / (IL) = 0.5 T.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Sets up the vertical force equilibrium equation accounting for both spring forces, weight, and Ampere force.

title: Ampere's law application
description: Important: Correctly applies F = BIL to relate Ampere force to magnetic field, current, and length.

title: Direction reasoning
description: Important: Uses the left-hand rule with given current direction and field orientation to determine force direction.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all quantities to consistent SI units (e.g., cm to m) before calculations.

title: Sign error in equilibrium
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly signs the Ampere force in the equilibrium equation (e.g., F_a = mg - 2kx).

title: Spring force mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses only one spring force instead of two, or misinterprets the elongation value.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Misapplies F = BIL (e.g., uses wrong length, omits current, or confuses with other formulas).
